_doc: Threshold / K / weight policy for the three task selectors. This is the *only* stage where cross-signal scoring is allowed (redesign-2026-05 §3).

highlight._doc: score = w_outlier · d_M(signal) + w_delta · |Δsignal|_sliding + w_diversity · diversity_term. Weights default per redesign §3 — α, β, γ. Tune on real source data.

diversity._doc: N per-subject samples evenly spread on the signal_statistics PC1 / PC2 plane. Soft target 8-12 per redesign §1.

standard._doc: One per-subject canonical record. Needs enough frontal frames to populate appearance + shape statistics stably.
